entries.name: MacMailSearchProcessing
entries.note: Mail search is limited to the open mailbox in mail-desktop/src/search.rs, and no message reaches the shell search index in springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs. Build a message indexer in the Mail app that feeds the Search panel.

entries.name: MacSystemUI
entries.note: The menu bar, dock and control centre are drawn by the shell, so the system chrome exists. Not mirrored: a shared chrome library that other apps link, and extension points for third-party items.

entries.name: MachineSettings
entries.note: The Settings app with its pages and search is in the shell. Not covered: a framework that other apps use to add their own settings panes.

entries.name: MacinTalk
entries.note: Screen reader announcements are spoken through espeak-ng or espeak found on PATH, and stay silent without one. No speech engine is in packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt and apps have no speech API in the SDK, so voices for apps are missing.

entries.name: MacinTalkCore
entries.note: Screen reader announcements are spoken through espeak-ng or espeak found on PATH, and stay silent without one. Not mirrored: the reference speech core, its voice catalogue and its synthesis for apps.

entries.name: MagnifierServices
entries.note: The shell magnifier zooms the screen from magnifier.rs. Not mirrored: the reference zoom service process and its app intents.

entries.name: MagnifierSupport
entries.note: The shell magnifier zooms the screen from magnifier.rs. Not mirrored: the reference support code for the zoom feature and its app intents.

entries.name: Mail
entries.note: The Mail app has accounts, the window, IMAP and SMTP transport. Not mirrored: a shared mail framework that other apps link.

entries.name: MailCore
entries.note: Message headers, MIME parsing and draft rendering are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail model that other apps can open mailboxes through.

entries.name: MailSearchSchemaManifest
entries.note: Mail messages are not registered with the shell search index in springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs, so there is no searchable schema for them. Build the field schema for mail messages and send it to the shell index from the Mail app.

entries.name: MailService
entries.note: Account sync runs on worker threads in sync.rs while the window is open. Not mirrored: a background mail agent that keeps accounts synced while the app is closed.

entries.name: MailSupport
entries.note: The Mail window state and preferences are in mail-desktop. Not covered: support services that other mail components call.

entries.name: MailUI
entries.note: The Mail window's drawing and input are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail UI kit and the reference's mail web bundle.

entries.name: MailWebProcessSupport
entries.note: HTML mail is cleaned of scripts and remote content in html.rs and rendered in-process. Not mirrored: the reference's separate web process for mail content.

entries.name: MallocStackLogging
entries.note: valgrind traces heap allocations and leaks for debugging, which covers the purpose on Linux. It has no switch like the reference allocation logging, and apps get no in-process allocation log.

entries.name: ManagedAppsCore
entries.note: Policy engine for managed apps under enterprise device management. It applies rules pushed by a management server, and BifrOSt runs no enrolment or management server to receive them.

entries.name: ManagedAppsInterface
entries.note: Interface to the managed-apps policy engine of enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no management server, so there is no policy for it to apply.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssets
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the vendor's asset delivery service and its fetching from vendor servers.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsHelper
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the helper service process that runs the asset downloads for the reference system.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsHelperFetching
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the fetching service process of the reference helper.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsRelay
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the relay service process that hands asset state between the reference system and apps.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsXPC
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the XPC interface of the reference asset service, because BifrOSt uses its own IPC.

entries.name: ManagedClient
entries.note: Client side of enterprise device management. Its only extension applies configuration profiles pushed by a management server, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: ManagedConfiguration
entries.note: Store and installer for configuration profiles sent by enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no profile format and no enrolment.

entries.name: ManagedConfigurationFiles
entries.note: Files of installed configuration profiles for enterprise device management. They exist only when a management server installs profiles, and BifrOSt has none.

entries.name: ManagedOrganizationContacts
entries.note: Organisation directory contacts pushed by enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no managed directory to pull contacts from.

entries.name: ManagedSettingsObjC
entries.note: Objective-C binding for managed setting keys set by enterprise device management. BifrOSt sets no managed keys.

entries.name: ManagedSettingsSupport
entries.note: Support code for managed setting keys set by enterprise device management. BifrOSt sets no managed keys.

entries.name: Mangrove
entries.note: 2D drawing runs in-process in the bifrost-render cg module. Not mirrored: the separate graphics services agent process that the reference runs for drawing requests.
